_README.what: Fire & Blast: a hand-authored tier of the Permanent Injury Table — one hundred d100 rows for harm done by fire & blast, worst at 1 and best at 100.
_README.when: Roll it instead of the Permanent Injury Table when the thing that dropped you was a Fireball, a grenade, a musket at arm's length, lightning, steam, a burning grove or any explosion — anything that cooked, flashed or threw you.
_README.contract: Exactly 100 rows, d100 1-100 in order, categories in the shared band order, every injuryType unique within the table AND across every table on the registry (injuryTables.json). `cure` is the LOWEST rung of the shared cure ladder in injuries.json; `duration` is how long it lasts without it. Checked by tools/generate-injury-table.py --check.
_README.status: Hand-authored and locked. Edit rows by hand, keep the count at 100, run the check.

title: Fire & Blast
description: What fire, lightning, powder and pressure leave behind. Low is worse: the bottom is ash, the teens are burned lungs and lost eyes, the middle is weeks of blisters and ringing, the top is a body that learned to stand in it.
rules: A result is a story consequence, not a replacement for a GM ruling. Reroll or override anything that would ruin the table's fun or a player's night.
Roll d100 straight. The Injury Desk's death-save handoff and the Casino's survival roll skip row 1 (Death), because the saves already answered that question.
Low is worse. Rows 1-56 are the price of surviving; 57-70 are a bad week; 71-92 are marks, trauma and oddities; 93-100 are the luck of the survivor.
The cure listed is the LOWEST rung of the shared ladder (injuries.json cureLadder) that removes the row. Anything stronger works too.
Pick the tier table by what did the harm. If nothing on the registry fits, the Permanent Injury Table is the default and always applies.

bands.note: The one row the survival handoff skips.
Alive, and dying on a schedule unless the cure arrives.
The body is not going to be the same.
Weeks, a healer, or second-level magic.
A fortnight of being worse at something.
Shirts off, there is a story.
Months, or a season of care.
Something that should not have happened, did.

cureLadder.note: The ladder is shared: see injuries.json cureLadder. Treatment rows state their Medicine DC inline.

entries.description: There is a shape where you were and nothing in it to raise. Raise Dead needs a body; this needs the other kind of miracle.
entries.notes: Row 1 is skipped by the death-save handoff.

entries.description: You breathed the fire in. Your hit point maximum is halved and drops by a further 1d6 after every long rest until the cure; at zero you drown on dry land.
entries.duration: Weeks at most without the cure.

entries.description: A fragment is creeping toward the heart. Each time you take a critical hit, make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points. Surgery (Treatment, DC 20) can take it out; Heal can too.
Burned over most of the body. You cannot wear armour, your hit point maximum is reduced by 2d10, and you have one level of exhaustion that nothing short of the cure removes.

entries.injuryType: Arm Taken by the Blast, Weapon Side
entries.description: The arm you fought with went with the explosion. You have one arm and it is the other one.

entries.injuryType: Off Arm Gone to the Fire
entries.description: The off arm was burned past saving and taken at the elbow. No shield, no two-handed weapons.
You were holding it when it went. You can wield one thing at a time and nothing that needs two hands.
Shrapnel opened the leg and the surgeon finished it. Speed 20 feet on a peg; you cannot stand from prone without a hand or an action and a DC 10 Strength check.
The foot could not be saved. Your speed is reduced by 10 feet and you have disadvantage on saves against being knocked prone.
The fuse hand. Lose 1d3 fingers, cauterised as they went, so no bleeding and no feeling in what is left: disadvantage on checks with any tool held in that hand, and you cannot draw a bow.
The flash took the eyes. You are blinded; the eyes are there, so Heal and not Regenerate.
Both eardrums went with the boom and did not come back. You are deafened.

The smoke scarred what the fire did not reach. You cannot take the Dash action twice in one minute, and any further smoke forces a DC 12 Constitution save or you are incapacitated by coughing until the end of your next turn.
The fingers fused. You cannot do fine work with that hand, cannot use it for somatic components, and attack rolls with a weapon held in it are at disadvantage.
The flash burned the retinas. You cannot see at all in dim light and treat darkness as magical darkness.
A fragment sits against the spine. Your speed is halved and you have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws. Heal will remove it; so will surgery that might kill you.
The bolt went through the chest. Whenever you take lightning or thunder damage you must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution save or be stunned until the end of your next turn.
The pressure wave caved the ribs. Your hit point maximum is reduced by 10.
You inhaled flame. You speak only in a whisper and must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save to cast a spell with a verbal component.
The burns healed; the pain did not. Disadvantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration.
Scar tissue locked the knee straight. Your speed is reduced by 10 feet and you cannot stand from prone without help.
A powder flash burned one eye out. Disadvantage on ranged attacks beyond 30 feet and on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
The wave rattled the brain. Disadvantage on Intelligence checks and on Constitution saves to maintain concentration.
Both eardrums burst. You are deafened until they knit.
Both arms blistered to the shoulder. You cannot wear armour heavier than light.
entries.duration: Three weeks after treatment (DC 13); six without.

entries.description: You ran across it. Your speed is reduced by 10 feet.
entries.duration: Three weeks after treatment (DC 12); six without.

entries.description: A fragment in the joint. Attack rolls with that arm are at disadvantage until it is cut out (Treatment, DC 15) and the wound given two weeks.
entries.duration: Two weeks after the surgery; permanent without it.

entries.description: One level of exhaustion that no rest removes until the lungs clear.
Everything past 30 feet is a glare. Disadvantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks and on ranged attacks beyond 30 feet.
The blast cracked the breastbone. You cannot take the Dash action.
entries.duration: Four weeks after treatment (DC 12); eight without.

entries.description: Both palms blistered raw. Attack rolls are made at disadvantage, and somatic components fail on a natural 1.
entries.duration: Two weeks after treatment (DC 12); four without.

entries.description: Pressure injury to the lungs. You cannot hold your breath and have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.
You landed on your back thirty feet away. Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
The bolt went down one arm and left it numb under a fern of red scars. Disadvantage on attack rolls and checks with that arm.
Boiling steam down the throat. You can only whisper, and spells with a verbal component fail on a natural 1 on any d20 you roll for them.
Powder grit under the skin that shifts when you move. The first critical hit you take each day deals an extra 1d4 damage as it tears.
entries.duration: Three weeks after it is picked out (DC 14); permanent without.

entries.description: The burns went bad. Your hit point maximum is reduced by 5 and you have one level of exhaustion.
You hear the boom in every silence. Disadvantage on initiative rolls.
A burn the length of the forearm. Disadvantage on Strength (Athletics) checks.
A fragment in the calf, cauterised on the way in. Your speed is reduced by 5 feet.
entries.duration: Two weeks after treatment (DC 10); a month without.

entries.description: A headache behind the eyes that does not lift. Disadvantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration.
You cannot take the Dash action.
Black speckled burns across the backs of both hands. Disadvantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks and on checks with any tool.
Hoarse to a rasp. Disadvantage on Charisma (Performance) and (Persuasion) checks.
The fingers do not feel. Disadvantage on Dexterity checks that need fine control.
A spark burned a spot into one eye. Ranged attack rolls beyond 60 feet are at disadvantage.
You cannot wear a helmet; if your Armour Class counted one, reduce it by 1.
You clenched when it went off. Eating takes twice as long and you regain one fewer Hit Die from each long rest.
entries.duration: Two weeks after treatment (DC 10); a month without.

entries.description: You came down on the shoulder. Attack rolls with heavy weapons are at disadvantage.
Smoke-raw eyes that will not stop watering. Disadvantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
You sat in it. You cannot ride or sit a saddle.
A belt buckle heated and burned its shape into your hip. Disadvantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
Disadvantage on hearing-based Wisdom (Perception) checks until it is flushed out (Treatment, DC 10).
entries.duration: Ten minutes with a healer; two weeks without.

entries.description: Your own weapon's grip branded the palm. Attack rolls with that weapon are at disadvantage.
Bruised from the pressure wave across the whole trunk. Your hit point maximum is reduced by 5.
The lightning left you jumpy. Disadvantage on saving throws against being stunned.
Eyebrows, lashes and most of the hair burned off. Disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks with strangers, who cannot stop staring.
A cough you cannot suppress. Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
Grey specks of unburnt powder under the skin of the face. Cosmetic; a week of itching. See 88 if they never fade.
The grip is still too hot to hold properly. A minus 1 penalty on attack rolls with your main weapon.
Disadvantage on hearing-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
Attack rolls with firearms and crossbows are at disadvantage.
Disadvantage on Intelligence checks.
A flash burn across the face. Disadvantage on Charisma (Deception) checks; you look guilty of something.
Spells with a verbal component fail on a natural 1 on any d20 you roll for them.
The lightning left you charged. Your hair stands up and your clothes crackle: disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
Disadvantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
Disadvantage on Strength (Athletics) checks with that arm.
Spots in your vision. Disadvantage on initiative rolls.
Nothing lasting. Beasts with keen smell notice you first for a week, and so does everyone in a tavern.
A tight shiny burn scar along the jawline. Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks against anyone who has stood near a fire they did not light.
A blast-shaped scar, pale centre and ragged edge, across one side of the face. Cosmetic. People who know the spell know what made it.
They did not grow back. Disadvantage on Charisma (Deception) checks: your face reads wrong.
One ear a knot of scar. Cosmetic; disadvantage on hearing-based Wisdom (Perception) checks on that side.
A fern of fine red branching lines across the cheek and neck where the bolt left. Cosmetic, and the kind of thing people reach out to touch.
A scatter of small white scars across the chest where the fragments were picked out. Cosmetic.
The whole back is burn scar from the blast you turned away from. Cosmetic; shirts off, nobody asks twice.
The shape of your own buckle burned into the skin. Cosmetic, and specific enough to identify you.
You are frightened of any open flame larger than a torch while within 10 feet of it, unless you succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw at the start of your turn.
entries.duration: Months — or a season of care.

entries.description: Any sudden loud noise within 60 feet forces a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or you are stunned until the end of your next turn.
entries.duration: Months — or a season of care.

entries.description: Whenever fire damage is dealt to you, you have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn.
entries.duration: Months — or a season of care.

entries.description: You gain no benefit from a long rest taken within 30 feet of an open flame.
entries.duration: Months — or a season of care.

entries.description: You smell smoke that is not there. Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell, and on Wisdom (Insight) checks while anything is burning nearby.
entries.duration: Months — or a season of care.

entries.description: You cannot settle in a room without a second way out. Disadvantage on initiative rolls in a room with one door.
entries.duration: Months — or a season of care.

entries.description: You cannot get warm. Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against cold.
entries.duration: Months — or a season of care.

entries.description: On each long rest roll a d6: on a 1 you wake at the worst of it and gain no benefit from the rest.
entries.duration: Months — or a season of care.

entries.description: The burn scars itch whenever a fire is lit within 60 feet. No rule attaches; you always know.
entries.duration: Permanent — if you wanted it gone.

entries.description: The specks never faded. Soldiers and gunsmiths read them as a mark of someone who has been close to a misfire and lived.
Once per long rest you can breathe out a puff of sparks that lights a torch, a fuse or a campfire. You take 1 extra damage from any fire effect.
Metal sparks when you touch it. Advantage on saving throws against lightning; disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while wearing or carrying metal.
You recall every explosion you have ever witnessed in perfect detail. The GM may give you something nobody else saw.
You can hear a lit fuse within 60 feet through any amount of noise.
Resistance to fire damage from nonmagical sources: campfires, lamps, burning oil, a hot pan.
Advantage on saving throws against being deafened.
Advantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration when the damage is fire or thunder.
Advantage on Dexterity saving throws against area effects you can see coming.
An area heavily obscured by smoke is only lightly obscured for you.
Resistance to fire damage.
Once, when an area effect would reduce you to 0 hit points, you take no damage from it instead. Then the row is spent.
You stand up at 1 hit point and every flame within 30 feet, including the magical kind, goes out.
